Future<void> work(groups) async {
  for (final group in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    for (final item in await read(group)) { print(item); }
  }
  for (var index = 0; index < groups.length; index++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final list = [for (final item in await read(index)) item.id];
    print(list);
  }
  for (final item in await read()) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    for (final item in await read()) { print(item); }
  }
}
